claims.claim: Codex loads user skills from ~/.agents/skills/ and supports explicit $skill-name invocation.
Standalone skills are available in the ChatGPT desktop app, and ChatGPT/Codex can explicitly select skills from the prompt surface.
Claude Desktop's Code tab supports a local environment, a selected project folder, and skill selection from the prompt UI.
Claude users can upload a custom skill ZIP from Customize > Skills; this is separate from using Claude Code on a local Vault.
An Agent Skill is a directory containing a required SKILL.md file and optional supporting resources.
